domain: scientific discovery and falsification, intelligence analysis tradecraft, and knowledge provenance systems
axioms: An authority grade is real only if some consumer checks it; an unchecked label is a comment and will be ignored at scale.
Speculative and durable knowledge sharing one store and one retrieval surface will eventually be conflated, regardless of stated intent.
A hypothesis with no stated retiring observation, no observer, and no clock accumulates epistemic debt and never dies.
A pilot that cannot produce an outcome favoring the null is a demonstration, not a test, and the confidence it yields is unearned.
Evidence consistent with every candidate is non-diagnostic and must not contribute to a ranking (Analysis of Competing Hypotheses).
Any countable output of a new operation becomes a target; assume an optimizing agent will manufacture the cheapest artifact that satisfies the count.
A single coarse confidence grade collapses distinctions that matter — validated-in-adjacent-domain is not the same authority as free-associated analogy.
primitives: falsifiable prediction and its retiring observation
failure_mode: Systematically over-weights containment and under-weights generativity — will happily recommend the design that never produces a wrong idea because it never produces an idea.
Misses whether the operation is worth having at all; audits the guardrails around a concept without questioning the concept's category or name.
Can demand falsifiability at a granularity the practice cannot support, converting cheap exploratory moves into expensive experiments.
Blind to loop dynamics: judges each claim's lifecycle in isolation and misses oscillation, deadtime, or pace-layer thrash.
Tends to treat provenance machinery as free, ignoring the complexity cost the charter explicitly scores.
